abort.single_instance_allowed: MediLog is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

init.title: MediLog options
init.description: Choose the persons whose medical records MediLog keeps.

unknown_person.message: MediLog does not track person {person_id}. Add the person in the MediLog options.

unknown_medication.message: Medication {medication_id} does not exist. Create the medication first.

medication_in_use.message: The medication cannot be deleted because {count} records use it.

corrupt_file.message: {file} is not valid JSON. Restore it from the newest backup: {backup}

add_or_update_record.name: Add or update record
add_or_update_record.description: Adds a new record for a person, or updates the record with the given ID.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: The person the record belongs to.

id.name: Record ID
id.description: ID of the record to update. Leave empty to add a new record.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: When the measurement was taken or the medication given.

medication_id.name: Medication ID
medication_id.description: ID of a medication from the medication database.

medication_amount.name: Medication amount
medication_amount.description: Amount of the medication given. Defaults to 1.

delete_record.name: Delete record
delete_record.description: Deletes a record of a person by its ID.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: The person the record belongs to.

id.name: Record ID
id.description: ID of the record to delete.

get_records.name: Get records
get_records.description: Returns all records of a person.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: The person whose records to return.

get_person_list.name: Get person list
get_person_list.description: Returns the persons tracked by MediLog with their most recent record.

add_or_update_medication.name: Add or update medication
add_or_update_medication.description: Adds a new medication to the medication database, or updates the medication with the given ID.

id.name: Medication ID
id.description: ID of the medication to update. Leave empty to add a new medication.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the medication. Must be unique.

units.name: Units
units.description: Units of the medication amount, e.g. tablets, ml or sprays.

delete_medication.name: Delete medication
delete_medication.description: Deletes a medication from the database. A medication used by any record cannot be deleted.

id.name: Medication ID
id.description: ID of the medication to delete.

get_medications.name: Get medications
get_medications.description: Returns all medications from the medication database.

get_medication.name: Get medication
get_medication.description: Returns one medication by its ID.

id.name: Medication ID
id.description: ID of the medication to return.
